payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- When a verification tool cannot start, the operator receives its actionable error and an executable recovery handoff, and that operational failure does not consume source-code rework.
- When verification inputs are equivalent, admissible passing evidence is reused; changed or unavailable inputs revoke reuse, and failed checks still block.
- When the repaired commands run as a consumer, required fresh checks remain enabled and actual reuse or miss reasons and elapsed time are visible.

payload.name: requirements
payload.value: Preserve source, runtime, configuration, tool and destination binding, required live-ledger and platform checks, permissions, recovery and append-only history. Report only measured changes; do not obtain speed claims by disabling checks or admitting stale evidence.

payload.text: Observer repair: launch-failure regressions failed before the fix in candidate and destination paths. The repaired focused selection passes; a launched exit 126 remains a check failure. Early engine preflight now precedes candidate checks and prints a uv command that supplies candidate environment and destination cwd. Existing cache/input controls passed 135 tests. Packaged-consumer validation initially failed because its fixture omitted the existing locked markdownlint prerequisite; fixture now installs those same locked packages offline. No dependency versions or verification gates changed.

Observer consumer results: baseline-wheel to candidate-wheel upgrade and verification controls passed. Thirty warm runs reused all three Pyright platform checks, while the unscoped check executed thirty times. Fresh runs were 2.699s and 2.741s; warm median 1.603s; cold cache 4.031s on a 10,000-line fixture. Source errors, forced-fresh mode, malformed cache and a real TZ environment change all forced fresh checks as required. These are existing compiler-cache measurements, not evidence of an end-to-end redesign speedup. Installed-wheel CLI checks also preserved missing-tool and Permission denied errors with infrastructure_error=true and nonzero exit. Actual uv handoff probe selected candidate venv and candidate Ruff with destination cwd. The 200-test final affected group and 135 cache/input tests passed; full verification now running on the finished source.
